seo.title: Organic Clay & Oil Hair Colouring in Malaga
seo.description: Organic hair colouring with Secretos del Agua clays and oils in Malaga. Natural, healthy botanical colour in Torre de Benagalbón.

hero.text: Colour that breathes, shines and heals. Rediscover the true nature of your hair through the power of plants.
hero.imgAlt: Result of organic colouring with botanical clays at Salón Pilar Palomares in Torre de Benagalbón, Rincón de la Victoria, serving Añoreta, Chilches and Torre del Mar

philosophy.p1: We use botanical products that respect the hair structure while delivering a unique luminosity. We believe healthy hair is the foundation of all beauty.
philosophy.p2: At Pilar Palomares, we leave behind the aggression of synthetic dyes to embrace the power of micronised plants and vegetable oils. The result is hair that not only looks better, but is stronger, more hydrated and more flexible.
philosophy.quote: "Nature offers us the purest pigments to care for your essence without compromising your wellbeing."

card1.title: Structural Respect
card1.desc: We preserve the integrity of the fibre from within, avoiding chemical damage and maintaining its natural vitality.
card1.imgAlt: Application of organic clays respecting the hair structure at Salón Pilar Palomares

card2.title: Luminosity
card2.desc: Organic reflections that vibrate with natural light, creating deep dimension and avoiding any flat, block-colour effect.

card3.title: Consciousness
card3.desc: Sustainability and ethics in every pigment. We respect your health with treatments free from toxins and full of life.

barros.title: Gold & Original Clays
barros.desc: Pure botanical blends that act as hair phytotherapy. They cover grey hair naturally, adding multi-tonal reflections and strengthening the cuticle from within for visibly thicker, healthier hair that is full of life.
barros.imgAlt: Gold and Original botanical clay blends for healthy hair phytotherapy

oleos.title: Organic Pigment (Oils)
oleos.desc: A fusion of vegetable oils and pure pigments offering permanent, ammonia-free colour. A unique sensory experience that deeply hydrates and nourishes.
oleos.imgAlt: Colouring with natural oils and ammonia-free pigments for a three-dimensional shine

ritual.quote: "A moment to disconnect and reconnect with your own natural beauty."
ritual.imgAlt: Sensory massage and wellness ritual during organic colouring at Pilar Palomares
